scope: Factory-derived target contract for an independent TWRP recovery product; static inspection only, not an image release or phone test.

layout.size_basis: independently corroborated package GPT, rawprogram XML and partition XML, not just image length

limits: The captures are proprietary local artifacts, not redistribution permission.
Source hashes establish byte identity; this capture does not establish publisher authenticity.
Firmware compatibility and actual use by the driver require a separately authorized device test.
Previous summary.json and input-display.json remain immutable snapshots; this separate receipt closes their firmware-content-hash gap.

remaining: Stage the exact captured ODM touch firmware without exposing unrelated private files or executing firmware on the host.
Validate effective recovery boot/vendor_boot composition and driver load ordering.
Verify runtime panel choice, DRM behavior, touch event/axis handling and orientation on authorized hardware.
CRC provider matching is not proof of full ABI, signature trust, runtime module selection or successful probe.

stock_recovery_chain.key_origin: Corresponding child image, not an independently authenticated OEM root

outstanding_checks: Build and inspect the independent recovery target; this record is not a compiled-image claim.
Validate TWRP policy with neverallows and no permissive domains; check all file/property/service contexts.
Verify expected recovery-mode detection and successful first-stage loading of the existing vendor ramdisk closure.
Stage or mount exact Nezha touch modules and firmware with matching providers; vendor_boot does not contain the touch pair.
Prove DRM rendering, panel brightness and touch coordinates on the authorized hardware.
Prove authenticated ADB and readable recovery/kernel logs without mounting or modifying userdata.
Verify live partition capacities, actual bootloader authorization and rollback constraints before any separate phone test.
Validate boot control, Virtual A/B snapshots and fastbootd before exposing write, slot-change, merge or backup/restore actions.
Validate Android 16 hardware-wrapped FBE and metadata encryption separately, without key upgrades or formatting.
